package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for select_or_get_inside_loop_lookup: ORM lookups (Select, Get, First, etc.) executed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule297PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func scenario297Positive(db *gorm.DB, orderIDs []int) ([]Rule297PositiveRecord, error) {
	var results []Rule297PositiveRecord
	for _, id := range orderIDs {
		var item Rule297PositiveRecord
		if err := db.Where("id = ?", id).First(&item).Error; err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		results = append(results, item)
	}
	return results, nil
}
